kind: targeted implementation and validation; not a new full repository audit
contract: Both create.directory and resolve.path accept the same POSIX auto syntax under native and root identities. Leading / is absolute; all other input is relative to the trusted execution home/projects.

Lexical normpath/abspath collapses duplicate separators, trailing separators, dot and dot-dot. Relative parent traversal is intentional. Only / is a Linux separator; backslash and Windows-reserved punctuation are literal POSIX names. No 80-character restriction or whitespace trim.

Reject empty input, control characters, invalid Unicode, extra payload properties and requests above 4096 bytes. Creating / reports already existing; resolving / is allowed subject to actual permissions.

Relative creation initializes only the default projects directory and fsyncs its home entry. Arbitrary nested parents must already exist. Absolute creation never initializes default projects. Resolve never mkdir.

Parent missing/non-directory, existing destination, EACCES/EPERM, EROFS and ENAMETOOLONG/EINVAL are classified before creation. Permission messages distinguish parent traversal from mkdir writability and do not automatically elevate. Read-only errors do not promise root can fix the filesystem.

Successful mkdir is followed by new-directory and parent fsync, canonical readback and response budget check. All failures after mkdir remain unknown, including any unexpected DeployError; no replayable not_sent reply is produced.
native_main supplies the trusted cwd for both operations. Its fixed UID/GID, root authorization and capability checks remain active. Payload cannot choose mode, home or UID.
evidenceBoundaries: Real Linux root fixture launches helper subprocesses as actual uid/gid 0 and 65534 with independent disposable homes; installed-helper request processing, ownership and permission failures are live.

Filesystem EACCES/EPERM/EROFS/readback/fsync failures are injected where specified. EROFS is not a real remounted read-only filesystem. Real parent mode 0700 and 0555 exercise traversal and write denial without mocks.
Root permission is fixture-owned root configuration; no real instance policy, account, service, proxy, provider, nftables or online deployment was changed. No personal credential content was read.
Only the two affected project test modules and one existing legacy-resolution compatibility test ran; no full suite, live production verification or independent full audit is claimed.
Earlier root-only absolute syntax was superseded before tests by the final unified auto contract; it is not part of this implementation or its acceptance.
